about_the_game:
Are you sick and tired of janky, bug-riddled games? If so, I highly recommend you never return to this Steam page again. If the bugs don't bother you too much, then BUCKLE UP, because you are in for the ride of your life.

Catto Pew Pew! CLASSIC is a chaotic physics-based arena shooter where your shots cause your opponent to fly backward. Smart movement, accuracy, and spam clicking are all seen throughout battles, where getting shot into the sunset is the norm. Best played with friends, Catto Pew Pew! CLASSIC is a fun, frenzied take on the Arena Shooter genre.

Features:

• Shoot your friends and foes off into the sky using the power of stupid-fun

• Proximity Chat allows you to hear your opponent's rage-filled gamer screaming fade away into the skyline as you send them farther and farther away

• Duke it out with up to 16 players in one of the fourteen havoc-filled arenas available

*7 Maps are available with the base game.

Gamemodes:

Free for All

• Constant action ensues as players constantly respawn

Chaos

• Spawn with no shield, go flying!

Timed

• Player with the least amount of deaths by the end of the match wins

Scramble

• Try and run down your timer while preventing other players from running down theirs.
detailed_description:
🚨 SEQUEL INCOMING 🚨

The ultimate version of Catto Pew Pew! is right around the corner! Featuring VR/PC crossplay, powerups, ranks, and more, this sequel takes what made Catto Pew Pew! CLASSIC fun and cranks it up by 10.

Wishlist it now here on Steam!

On a more personal note:

After developing the sequel for almost three years, seeing how this game brings people together for some laughs has been awesome. Watching a group of friends (or even a bunch of strangers) yelling at each other while grinning ear to ear from playing your game is the best feeling in the world. 

Thanks for the years of support—I can't wait for you guys to play my new game :)

- Oakley Blade, Developer

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core Duo Processor (2GHz or better)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ATI Radeon HD 4350
  • Additional Notes: All OS's aside from Windows have been undertested. Feel free to report any issues you find to oakleybladegames.help@gmail.com so I can do my best to fix them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-Bit Windows
  • Processor: Intel Core Duo Processor (2GHz or better)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ATI Radeon HD 4350
  • Additional Notes: This game should run okay on lower end computers. Through testing, an average of 100 FPS was achieved with minimum graphics settings at 840x420 resolution with the above specs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Additional Notes: If you are using a computer made in the past 10-15 years, you are probably able to run this game fine.
